package directory

import (
	"context"
	current "github.com/Agent-Field/codeaf/internal/directory"
	"net/http"
	"strconv"
)

type Rotation = current.Rotation
type RotationReq = current.RotationReq
type RotationView = current.RotationView
type PresenceView = current.PresenceView
type Approval struct {
	Device Device `json:"device"`
	Cert   string `json:"cert"`
	Grant  string `json:"grant"`
}
type vaultSwap struct {
	Old string `json:"old"`
	New string `json:"new"`
}
type fenceBody struct {
	Fence uint64 `json:"fence"`
}

const MaxBody = 1 << 20
const VersionHeader = current.VersionHeader

var (
	ErrStillPending    = current.ErrStillPending
	ErrRotated         = current.ErrRotated
	ErrRotationStep    = current.ErrRotationStep
	ErrBadGrace        = current.ErrBadGrace
	ErrTooManyWatchers = current.ErrTooManyWatchers
	ErrRequestGone     = current.ErrRequestGone
	ErrAlreadyDecided  = current.ErrAlreadyDecided
	ErrTooBig          = current.ErrTooBig
	ErrFull            = current.ErrFull
	ErrBadRequest      = current.ErrBadRequest
)

func (h *HTTP) Presence(ctx context.Context) (v PresenceView, err error) {
	hdr, err := h.doHeader(ctx, http.MethodGet, dirBase+"/presence", nil, &v)
	if err == nil {
		v.Version, _ = strconv.ParseUint(hdr.Get(VersionHeader), 10, 64)
	}
	return v, err
}
